name: NOXA Fun Launch Locker

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A lead deliberately left open in an earlier pass, resolved properly this time: every one of the 36 real function selectors in the locker’s bytecode was extracted and checked against a public signature database - no principal-moving function exists anywhere in the set.
narrative.tag: a real negative result, not a partial scan
narrative.detail: owner() is a bare EOA. The only state-changing functions found are a fee-management module (setFeeCollector/setProtocolFeeRecipient/setProtocolFeeShare/collectFees) plus standard OZ Ownable/NFT-receiver selectors - no withdraw/unlock/migrate/decreaseLiquidity/sweep anywhere. The locker genuinely holds 60,142 real Uniswap V3 LP positions (confirmed live), just with no selector that could move them out. Scored as a standalone bare-EOA target, same convention as Curve DEX.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (45 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# owner() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x7f03effbd7ceb22a3f80dd468f67ef27826acd85","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x5245a5f"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (45 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x5245a5f"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 86268089 and 86268511 of the chain

reproduce.note: this RPC cannot replay the block of the build (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build; compare the composite and lastUpdated with this page

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 45 transactions sent; delay: none
